result.response:
The **Design** phase (`/v0-design`) for Story **P2-P** (`p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications` — *Frontend Shell, Dashboard & In-App Notifications*) is complete and ready for your review at the **Design Gate**.

### Produced Design Artifacts

1. **Feature OpenAPI 3.0.3 Contract Draft:** [openapi.yaml](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/docs/agents-v0/design/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/openapi.yaml)
   - Self-contained contract draft covering all 10 operations consumed by the portal shell, Dashboard, and Notification Bell drawer: `initiateOidcLogin` (`GET /api/v1/auth/login`), `handleOidcCallback` (`GET /api/v1/auth/callback`), `getCurrentPrincipal` (`GET /api/v1/auth/me`), `logoutSession` (`POST /api/v1/auth/logout`), `mockLogin` (`POST /api/v1/auth/mock-login`), `getDashboardWidgets` (`GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets`), `listNotifications` (`GET /api/v1/notifications`), `getNotificationById` (`GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}`), `markNotificationRead` (`POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`), and `markAllNotificationsRead` (`POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`).
   - Enforces `additionalProperties: false` on write request schemas (`MockLoginRequest`, `NotificationReadRequest`), `Idempotency-Key` headers on `POST` mutations, `X-Correlation-ID` response headers, and RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail` (`application/problem+json`).

2. **Architecture & Traceability Specification:** [design.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/docs/agents-v0/design/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/design.md), [ADR 0021](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/docs/agents-v0/adr/0021-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications.md) (`Status: Proposed`), & [frontend-shell.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/docs/agents-v0/diagrams/sequences/frontend-shell.md)
   - **Traceability:** Maps `AC-1` through `AC-8` and all 5 NFRs to OpenAPI `operationId`s, React 19 modules under `app/frontend/src/`, UX components, and ADR sections.
   - **In-Memory Client State:** Defines `PrincipalSessionResponse`, `DashboardWidgetsResponse`, `NotificationListState`, and `ActiveProblemDetail` kept strictly in React memory with zero persistence in `localStorage` or `sessionStorage`.
   - **Authorization & Threat Model (VAPT `F4`, `F8`, `F9`, `F10`):** Documents permission-filtered navigation (`AUDIT_DASHBOARD_READ`, `EXECUTION_RUNS_READ`, `CONFIG_*_READ`, `GOVERNANCE_TICKETS_READ`, `IAM_*_READ` / `AUDIT_LOGS_READ`), zero-role `ROLE_APPLY_ONBOARDING` redirection, `encodeURIComponent(id)` BOLA path encoding, `View-As` read-only mutation blocking (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`), `X-Correlation-ID` + W3C `traceparent` header injection, XSS-safe text rendering (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), and fail-closed `401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED` / `503 SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` handling.

3. **UX Specification & Static HTML Mockups:** [ux-spec.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/docs/agents-v0/design/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/ux-spec.md) & `docs/agents-v0/design/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications/mockups/`
   - Covers Mermaid user flows, per-screen state matrices (`Loading`, `Error`, `Empty`, `Success`), 28 interactive `data-component` rows mapped to OpenAPI `operationId`s, WCAG 2.1 Level AA keyboard focus trapping and reduced-motion rules, responsive breakpoints, GCash token conformance, and 14 static HTML mockups:
